'''Effluents''' are three debuffs found in arenas in several [[Doedre]]-related boss rooms:

Each debuff can stack up to 10 times.

The debuffs are not the same as {{sl|id=TemporalChains}}, {{sl|id=Enfeeble}} and {{sl|id=TempestVulnerability}} debuffs which used in the [[Act 4]] [[Doedre Darktongue]] fight (map versions: [[Prodigy of Hexes]]/[[Erythrophagia]]), or another set of 3 debuffs (Doedre's Suffering/Torment/Withering) from the [[Doedre, Darksoul]] fight in [[Act 9]] (map version: [[Doedre the Defiler]]). However, the latter set use the same icons as Effluents.
==List of effluents==
